points.description: States at least 4 valid objectives of IPv6 from: supporting billions of end-systems (large address space); reducing routing tables; simplifying protocol processing (simplified header); increasing security; supporting real-time data traffic / quality of service. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark for at least 4 correct IPv6 objectives from the model answer list, in any wording. Fewer than 4 correct objectives earns no mark. Incorrect extra items do not earn marks.
